_status: NON-NORMATIVE. Each entry names a property violation and the guard that must go red when it is introduced. A guard that has never been observed to fail is an untested assertion with a Makefile target.
_isolation: Every mutation runs in a throwaway git worktree created from HEAD and removed afterwards. The primary worktree is never mutated: the thing being proven is that a guard goes red, and the cost of proving it must not be the working tree.

mutations.violation: the Key Manifest contract stops requiring threshold signatures, returning the model to a single root key
signature entries are counted instead of distinct authorities, so one custodian signing twice reaches the threshold alone
